title: TikTok comments are getting more interactive with voice comments, polls, and more
summary: TikTok’s comments section is getting an upgrade. With the additions, the app is borrowing features from messaging apps as it looks to deepen engagement on its platform. […]

summary: The once-dominant mapping app has surged to the top of Apple’s U.S. App Store after refusing to adopt Trump’s “Lake America” name, drawing more than half of its 2026 U.S. downloads in just six days.
